exams.name: Licensing examination (RN)
exams.notes: Written exam; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination. Board passes or rejects all applicants.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by Board of Registered Nursing)
exams.quote: Examinations shall be written, but in the discretion of the board may be supplemented by an oral or practical examination in such subjects as the board determines.

exams.name: National nurse practitioner board certification examination
exams.notes: Required for NPs seeking independent practice authority under Section 2837.103; must be from a national certifying body accredited by NCCA or ABNS and recognized by the board.
exams.quote: Passed a national nurse practitioner board certification examination and, if applicable, any supplemental examination developed pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision (a) of Section 2837.105.

exams.name: Licensing examination (LVN)
exams.notes: Written exam; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination. Minimum two per year.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by Board of Vocational Nursing and Psychiatric Technicians)
exams.quote: Examinations shall be written, but in the discretion of the board may be supplemented by an oral or practical examination in such subjects as the board determines.

exams.name: Nursing Home Administrator licensing examination (state and national)
exams.notes: Both a state and national examination required unless applicant scored at least 75% on national exam in another state (then state exam only). Minimum 75% passing score.
exams.quote: every applicant for an initial license as a nursing home administrator shall pass a nursing home administrator licensing examination, which shall consist of a state and national examination.

interval_years.quote: Each person holding a regular renewable license under this chapter, whether in an active or inactive status, shall apply for a renewal of their license and pay the biennial renewal fee required by this chapter every two years

required.quote: Each person renewing their license under Section 2811 shall submit proof satisfactory to the board that, during the preceding two-year period, they have been informed of the developments in the registered nurse field or in any special area of practice engaged in by the licensee

hours_per_period.quote: The continuing education standards established by the board shall not exceed 30 hours of direct participation in a course or courses approved by the board, or its equivalent in the units of measure adopted by the board.

value: implicit bias (in all CE courses with direct patient care component)
Schedule II controlled substances and addiction risks (for NPs/CNMs with DEA numbers and Schedule II authority)
topical_requirements.quote: the board shall adopt regulations to require that, on and after January 1, 2022, all continuing education courses for licensees under this chapter contain curriculum that includes the understanding of implicit bias.

available.quote: the board upon written application may issue a license without examination to any applicant who is licensed or registered as a nurse in a state, district, or territory of the United States or Canada having, in the opinion of the board, requirements for licensing or registration equal to or higher than those in California at the time the application is filed

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed/registered in a U.S. state, territory, D.C., or Canada with requirements equal to or higher than California's at time of application; must have passed a comparable examination; and must meet all other requirements of Section 2736.
requirements.quote: the board upon written application may issue a license without examination to any applicant who is licensed or registered as a nurse in a state, district, or territory of the United States or Canada having, in the opinion of the board, requirements for licensing or registration equal to or higher than those in California at the time the application is filed with the Board of Registered Nursing, if they have passed an examination for the license or registration that is, in the board's opinion, comparable to the board's examination, and if they meet all the other requirements set forth in Section 2736.

exists.quote: The board shall establish a Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee to advise and make recommendations to the board on all matters relating to nurse practitioners

name.value: Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee; Nurse-Midwifery Advisory Committee
name.quote: The board shall establish a Nurse Practitioner Advisory Committee to advise and make recommendations to the board on all matters relating to nurse practitioners, including, but not limited to, education, appropriate standard of care, and other matters specified by the board.

authority.value: Advisory — makes recommendations to the board on education, standard of care, disciplinary guidance; provides recommendations when board is considering disciplinary action
authority.quote: The committee shall make recommendations to the board on all matters related to midwifery practice, education, appropriate standard of care, and other matters as specified by the board. The committee shall provide recommendations or guidance on care when the board is considering disciplinary action against a certified nurse-midwife.

national_certification.value: National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists (NBCRNA)
national_certification.quote: the board shall certify all applicants who can show certification by the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists or a successor national professional organization approved by the board.

national_association.value: American College of Nurse-Midwives; National Organization of Nurse Practitioner Faculties (NONPF); International Nursing Association for Clinical Simulation and Learning; National Council of State Boards of Nursing; Society for Simulation in Healthcare
national_association.quote: consistent with the Core Competencies for Basic Midwifery Practice adopted by the American College of Nurse-Midwives, or its successor national professional organization, as approved by the board

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person or persons not licensed or certified as provided in this chapter to use the title 'registered nurse,' the letters 'R.N.,' or the words 'graduate nurse,' 'trained nurse,' or 'nurse anesthetist.'

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence or gross negligence in carrying out usual certified or licensed nursing functions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence or gross negligence in carrying out usual certified or licensed nursing functions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of practicing medicine without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of practicing medicine without a license in violation of Chapter 5 (commencing with Section 2000), in which event the record of conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of advertising relating to nursing that violates Section 17500.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of advertising relating to nursing that violates Section 17500.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial, revocation, suspension, restriction, or other disciplinary action by another state, territory, government agency, or California health care professional licensing board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial of licensure, revocation, suspension, restriction, or any other disciplinary action against a health care professional license or certificate by another state or territory of the United States, by any other government agency, or by another California health care professional licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring a certificate or license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring their certificate or license by fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision or term of the chapter or regulations adopted pursuant to it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violating of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this chapter or regulations adopted pursuant to it.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with an application for a certificate or license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or giving any false statement or information in connection with the application for issuance of a certificate or license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a registered nurse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a registered nurse, in which event the record of the conviction shall be conclusive evidence thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating any applicant or acting as proxy for an applicant in any examination required under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating any applicant or acting as proxy for an applicant in any examination required under this chapter for the issuance of a certificate or license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another certified or licensed practitioner, or permitting another person to use their certificate or license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another certified or licensed practitioner, or permitting or allowing another person to use their certificate or license for the purpose of nursing the sick or afflicted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting in the performance of or arranging for a violation of the Medical Practice Act provisions on unauthorized practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting, or agreeing to aid or assist any person or persons, whether a licensed physician or not, in the performance of, or arranging for, a violation of any of the provisions of Article 12 (commencing with Section 2220) of Chapter 5.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as a nurse practitioner or as certified as a nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife, clinical nurse specialist, or public health nurse without meeting board standards or certification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to the public or to any practitioner of the healing arts as a nurse practitioner or as meeting the standards established by the board for a nurse practitioner unless meeting the standards established by the board pursuant to Article 8 (commencing with Section 2834) or holding oneself out to the public as being certified by the board as a nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife, clinical nurse specialist, or public health nurse unless the person is at the time certified by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines, risking transmission of blood-borne infectious diseases.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except for good cause, the knowing failure to protect patients by failing to follow infection control guidelines of the board, thereby risking transmission of blood-borne infectious diseases from licensed or certified nurse to patient, from patient to patient, and from patient to licensed or certified nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, possessing, prescribing, or administering controlled substances in violation of law, or using them to an extent dangerous to self or others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtain or possess in violation of law, or prescribe, or except as directed by a licensed physician and surgeon, dentist, or podiatrist administer to themselves, or furnish or administer to another, any controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or making grossly incorrect or unintelligible entries in hospital, patient, or other records pertaining to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsify, or make grossly incorrect, grossly inconsistent, or unintelligible entries in any hospital, patient, or other record pertaining to the substances described in subdivision (a) of this section.

insurance_required.quote: A nurse practitioner practicing under this section shall have professional liability insurance appropriate for the practice setting.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing within the meaning of this chapter means those functions, including basic health care, that help people cope with difficulties in daily living that are associated with their actual or potential health or illness problems or the treatment thereof, and that require a substantial amount of scientific knowledge or technical skill
definition_quote.quote: The practice of nursing within the meaning of this chapter means those functions, including basic health care, that help people cope with difficulties in daily living that are associated with their actual or potential health or illness problems or the treatment thereof, and that require a substantial amount of scientific knowledge or technical skill

value: direct and indirect patient care services ensuring safety, comfort, personal hygiene, and protection
performance of disease prevention and restorative measures
administration of medications and therapeutic agents
implementation of treatment, disease prevention, or rehabilitative regimens ordered by physicians, dentists, podiatrists, or clinical psychologists
skin tests, immunization techniques, and withdrawal of human blood from veins and arteries
observation of signs and symptoms and implementation of standardized procedures or emergency procedures
methods_authorized.quote: Direct and indirect patient care services that ensure the safety, comfort, personal hygiene, and protection of patients; and the performance of disease prevention and restorative measures.

drug_authority.value: RNs may administer medications and therapeutic agents under physician/dentist/podiatrist/clinical psychologist orders. CNMs may furnish/order drugs including Schedule II-V controlled substances (with board furnishing number, DEA registration, and protocols). NPs under standardized procedures may furnish Schedule II-V controlled substances. NPs practicing independently under Section 2837.103 may prescribe/furnish pharmacological agents including controlled substances with a board-issued furnishing number and DEA registration.
drug_authority.quote: Neither this chapter nor any other law shall be construed to prohibit a certified nurse-midwife from furnishing or ordering drugs or devices, including controlled substances classified in Schedule II, III, IV, or V under the California Uniform Controlled Substances Act

value: Temporary Permit/Interim Permit to Practice Nursing
license_tiers.quote: board-issued certification includes, but is not limited to, certification as a nurse practitioner, nurse practitioner with a furnishing number, nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife, nurse midwife with a furnishing number, public health nurse, clinical nurse specialist, or board listed psychiatric mental health nurse.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means those licensed registered nurses who have met the requirements of Article 2.5 (commencing with Section 2746), Article 7 (commencing with Section 2825), Article 8 (commencing with Section 2834), or Article 9 (commencing with Section 2838).

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: the performance of services requiring those technical, manual skills acquired by means of a course in an approved school of vocational nursing, or its equivalent, practiced under the direction of a licensed physician and surgeon or registered nurse

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: pursuant to policies and protocols that are mutually agreed upon by a physician and surgeon, that delineate the parameters for consultation, collaboration, referral, and transfer of a patient's care, and that are signed by both the certified nurse-midwife and a physician and surgeon

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Beginning January 1, 2023, notwithstanding any other law, the following apply to a nurse practitioner who holds an active certification issued by the board pursuant to subdivision (b)

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The furnishing or ordering of drugs or devices by a certified nurse-midwife is conditional on the issuance by the board of a number to the applicant who has successfully completed the requirements of paragraph (2).

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: Drugs or devices furnished or ordered by a nurse practitioner may include Schedule II through Schedule V controlled substances under the California Uniform Controlled Substances Act

dea_registration_required.quote: Every certified nurse-midwife who is authorized pursuant to this section to furnish or issue a drug order for a controlled substance shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Every certified nurse-midwife who is authorized pursuant to this section to furnish or issue a drug order for a controlled substance shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration and the Controlled Substance Utilization Review and Enforcement System (CURES) pursuant to Section 11165.1 of the Health and Safety Code.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A health facility licensed pursuant to subdivision (a), (b), or (f), of Section 1250 of the Health and Safety Code shall not assign unlicensed personnel to perform nursing functions in lieu of a registered nurse and may not allow unlicensed personnel to perform functions under the direct clinical supervision of a registered nurse that require a substantial amount of scientific knowledge and technical skills

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Any employer of a licensed vocational nurse shall report to the board the suspension or termination for cause, or resignation for cause, of any licensed vocational nurse in its employ.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: It is the intent of the Legislature that the Board of Registered Nursing seek ways and means to identify and rehabilitate registered nurses whose competency may be impaired due to abuse of alcohol and other drugs, or due to mental illness so that registered nurses so afflicted may be rehabilitated and returned to the practice of nursing in a manner that will not endanger the public health and safety. It is also the intent of the Legislature that the Board of Registered Nursing shall implement this legislation by establishing an intervention program as a voluntary alternative to traditional disciplinary actions.

public_health_nurse_certification_availa.quote: No individual shall hold himself or herself out as a public health nurse or use a title which includes the term 'public health nurse' unless that individual is in possession of a valid California public health nurse certificate issued pursuant to this article.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: The utilization of a nurse anesthetist to provide anesthesia services in an acute care facility shall be approved by the acute care facility administration and the appropriate committee, and at the discretion of the physician, dentist or podiatrist.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: The certificate to practice nurse-midwifery authorizes the holder to attend pregnancy and childbirth in an out-of-hospital setting if consistent with subdivisions (a), (b), and (c).

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: The standardized procedure or protocol shall be developed and approved by the supervising physician and surgeon, the nurse practitioner, and the facility administrator or the designee.

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: An approved school of nursing or nursing program shall meet a minimum of 500 direct patient care clinical hours in a board-approved clinical setting

implicit_bias_training_required_in_curri.quote: Graduation requirements for an approved school of nursing, or an approved nursing program, shall include one hour of direct participation in an implicit bias training

military_education_credit_required.quote: The board shall deny the application for approval made by, and shall revoke the approval given to, any school of nursing that does not give student applicants credit in the field of nursing for military education and experience by the use of challenge examinations or other methods of evaluation.

scope__license_tiers.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing, as defined in Section 2725, without holding a license that is in an active status issued under this chapter except as otherwise provided in this act. Every licensee may be known as a registered nurse and may place the letters "R.N." after their name.
Every licensee under this chapter may be known as a licensed vocational nurse and may place the letters "L.V.N." after the licensee's name.

"Advanced practice registered nurse" means those licensed registered nurses who have met the requirements of Article 2.5 (commencing with Section 2746), Article 7 (commencing with Section 2825), Article 8 (commencing with Section 2834), or Article 9 (commencing with Section 2838).
The board shall issue a certificate to practice nurse anesthesia to any person who qualifies under this article and is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

No person shall advertise or hold himself out as a "nurse practitioner" who is not a nurse licensed under this chapter and does not, in addition, meet the standards for a nurse practitioner established by the board.
The board shall issue a certificate to practice nurse-midwifery to any person who qualifies under this article and is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

No person shall advertise or hold himself or herself out as a "clinical nurse specialist" unless he or she is a nurse licensed under this chapter, and meets the standards for a clinical nurse specialist established by the board.

The board shall issue a certificate to perform the functions specified in subdivision (c) of Section 2837.103 pursuant to that subdivision outside of the settings and organizations specified under subparagraphs (A) to (F), inclusive, of paragraph (2) of subdivision (a) of Section 2837.103
There is hereby established in the State Department of Health Services a Nursing Home Administrator Program (NHAP), which shall license and regulate nursing home administrators.

Upon approval of an application filed pursuant to subdivision (b) of Section 2732.1, and upon the payment of the fee prescribed by subdivision (k) of Section 2815, the board may issue a temporary license to practice professional nursing

scope__aprn_role_categories.quote: No person shall advertise or hold himself out as a "nurse practitioner" who is not a nurse licensed under this chapter and does not, in addition, meet the standards for a nurse practitioner established by the board.
The board shall issue a certificate to practice nurse anesthesia to any person who qualifies under this article and is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.
The board shall issue a certificate to practice nurse-midwifery to any person who qualifies under this article and is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

No person shall advertise or hold himself or herself out as a "clinical nurse specialist" unless he or she is a nurse licensed under this chapter, and meets the standards for a clinical nurse specialist established by the board.
